record.title: Off axis example of Biot Savart Law
record.name: OffAxisExampleOfBiotSavartLaw
record.content:
$r = x \hat{x} + z \hat{z}$ \\ $r' = r' \cos \phi' \hat{x} + r' \sin \phi' \hat{y}$ \\ $dl = -r d\phi' \sin \phi' \hat{x} + r d\phi' \cos \phi' \hat{y} $\\ $ r - r' = (x - r' \cos \phi') \hat{x} + r' \sin \phi' \hat{y} + z \hat{z}$ \\ $ dl \times (r - r') = zr' d\phi \cos \phi' \hat{x} + zr'd\phi \sin \phi' \hat{y} + [- x r' d\phi cos\phi' + r'^2 d\phi] \hat{z} $ \\
$ \left | r - r' \right | = =$
